SUSHMA YERRAM Power Platform Developer

 sushmayerram928@gmail.com	 +9197989814401	 Bangalore, India  

3.8 years of experience in developing end-to-end business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.

Skilled in designing Dataverse data models, business rules, security roles, and optimizing scalable applications.

Expertise in building complex automation workflows including approvals, integrations, scheduled flows, and exception handling.

Hands-on experience using AI Builder for document processing and intelligent automation. Strong integration experience with REST APIs, premium connectors, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint. Proficient in Power Fx, expressions, JSON parsing, and performance optimization.

Experienced in ALM practices, solution management across Dev/Test/Prod, and deployment processes.

Known for converting manual processes into efficient automated solutions that enhance productivity and accuracy.

Experienced in designing and deploying enterprise-grade Copilot solutions using Copilot Studio, leveraging Generative AI (RAG), structured topics, and enterprise knowledge sources to enable intelligent, secure, and scalable conversational experiences.

Proficient in integrating Copilot Studio with Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365, implementing human escalation, governance controls, and end-to-end automation to improve business productivity and user engagement.

Power Platform Developer VN2 Solutions Pvt. Ltd

Project: Service Request & Ticketing System

07/2025 – Present

 Developed a centralized ticketing system using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Teams.  Built a multi-role Canvas App for employees and technicians to raise and track service requests.

 Automated ticket assignment, notifications, and SLA monitoring, reducing response time significantly.

 Integrated Teams Adaptive Cards for real-time technician updates and improved workflow visibility.  Designed Dataverse tables and Power BI dashboards for analytics and SLA performance.

Utsah Sotware SolutionsPvt.Ltd	01/2023 – 06/2025

Project: Intelligent HR Policy & Leave Management Copilot

 Built an Intelligent HR Copilot using Copilot Studio to answer employee queries on HR policies, leave balances, and holidays using Generative AI (RAG).

 Integrated SharePoint as a knowledge source and Dataverse to store leave requests, balances, and approval history with role-based security.



 Developed Power Automate flows for multi-level leave approvals, automated notifications, reminders, and status updates.

 Connected Copilot and leave workflows with Power Apps (Canvas App) and deployed the solution in Microsoft Teams with Azure AD authentication.

 Implemented fallback topics, human escalation, error handling, and DLP policies to ensure secure, reliable, and enterprise-compliant automation.

AVK Software Solutions Pvt.Ltd	05/2022 – 12/2022

Project: Project Management & Resource Allocation Copilot

 Developed a Project Management Copilot using Copilot Studio to answer queries on project status, milestones, and resource allocation.

 Integrated Dataverse and SharePoint lists to track projects, tasks, and resource availability.  Automated task updates, approval workflows, and notifications using Power Automate.

 Built a Power Apps Canvas App for project and task management with role-based access.  Deployed the Copilot in Microsoft Teams with user-context–based responses

Primary Skills: Microsoft Power Apps(Canvas, Model-Driven), Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Fx, Microsoft 365 Integration, Power BI

Database Technology: Share point, Dataverse, Salesforce, SQL Server, On Premises data gateway

Integration & Automation: REST APIʼs, AI Builder

Extensive exposure to Power Apps Canvas App development, including multi-role interfaces, dynamic forms, galleries, validations, and interactive dashboards.

Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate workflows such as approvals, escalations, SLA monitoring, Teams/Outlook integration, AI Builder extraction, and REST API-based connectivity. Skilled in designing and managing Dataverse schemas, relationships, security roles, and implementing end-to-end business logic using tables, lookups, and automated updates.

Exposure to Power BI reporting and analytics, building dashboards for SLA tracking, attendance insights, invoice lifecycle trends, and department performance metrics.

Exposure to designing and deploying Copilot solutions using Copilot Studio, integrating Generative AI (RAG), enterprise knowledge sources, and Power Automate workflows to support intelligent, secure business automation.

Bachelor of Engineering (B.Tech, CSE),	2018 – 2022 | India Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering & Technology
